messages:
Emily Chen: Quick kickoff — CloudSilo marketplace listing + joint webinar/blog. Two asks: benchmark narrative + inbound lead routing. Lock by EOD Fri.

Dave Patel: Sounds good. Webinar date?

Emily Chen: Tentative May 14 09:00 PT. Might move to week of 5/20.

Alex R: Benchmark focus: latency/reliability with a short cost stat.

Maria Gomez: Agreed — headline with a single percent callout. Well include methodology details in appendix.

Dave Patel: SFDC mapping plan: marketplace_lead.id -> Lead.External_ID; company_size -> Lead.Number_of_Employees__c; interest_tag -> Lead.Product_Interest__c. Lead.Source = "CloudSilo Marketplace". Ill build the upsert flow.

Olivia Park: Webhook spec minimal fields: lead_id, email, name, company, title, interest_tag, company_size, sku_id, utm_source, priority, ts. Also support batch CSV.

Emily Chen: Sample payload for eng: {lead_id: "CS-987654", email: "jane@acme.com", name: "Jane Ramos", company: "ACME Corp", title: "Head of AI", interest_tag: "dedicated", company_size: "200-1000", sku_id: "SIL-42", utm_source: "cloudsilo_marketplace", priority: true, ts: 1768000000}

Alex R: Routing SLA: mark priority -> notify #marketplace-inbound within 10m; if unclaimed in 30m -> auto-assign to growth.

Maria Gomez: Ill draft the blog: exec blurb, methodology, results, how-to-get-started (marketplace link), FAQ, appendix with raw numbers.

Emily Chen: Assets list: hero PNG, social squares (2), blog feature image, benchmark visual (png/svg), speaker heads, 30s clip.

Dave Patel: Also include consent checkbox text on reg form: "By registering you consent to be contacted by Redwood Inference and CloudSilo about their products and services."

Emily Chen: Timeline checkpoint: Tue finalize numbers; Wed asset request; Thu webhook + SFDC ready; Fri blog draft; Mon confirm date + open registration. Ill sync with CloudSilo.

cal-bot: Calendar hold created May 14 09:00 PT — "Redwood x CloudSilo: Marketplace Launch Webinar". Use /accept to add to calendar.

Emily Chen: Thanks team :thumbsup:
